HowItWorks.title: How AnonProtect works
HowItWorks.subtitle: Understand, in detail, the path of your report, how we guarantee anonymity, and where Artificial Intelligence comes into play.
HowItWorks.step1Description: You fill out the form without providing name, email, or any personal data. The system does not require registration and does not log IPs to identify the origin.
HowItWorks.step2Description: At the end, you receive a unique tracking code. It is the only key to access your report and talk to the responsible team.
HowItWorks.step3Description: Our AI analyzes the text to suggest category and priority, helping the team organize the most critical cases without replacing human analysis.
HowItWorks.anonymityIntro: AnonProtect is designed so that not even administrators or developers can trace the origin of the report.
HowItWorks.anonymityItem1: No identification field is required in the report form.
HowItWorks.anonymityItem2: We do not store IPs in a way that allows direct identification of the whistleblower.
HowItWorks.anonymityItem3: Messages exchanged are linked only to the tracking code.
HowItWorks.aiUsageIntro: AnonProtect's Artificial Intelligence is used to support the ethics and compliance team, never to make final decisions in isolation.
HowItWorks.aiUsageItem1: AI suggests categories and priorities based on the report description.
HowItWorks.aiUsageItem2: The responsible team reviews each case before any forwarding or closure.
HowItWorks.aiUsageItem3: AI responses are auditable and go through technical validations to avoid errors.
HowItWorks.readyTitle: Ready to submit your report securely?
HowItWorks.readyDescription: You remain 100% anonymous throughout the entire process. Use the channel responsibly and sincerely.
